title: Number Systems
description: Zero, and "the next one". From two rules, all of arithmetic. Unlocks the Peano Arithmetic Engine.

old_puzzle.goal: Show how many steps of 'add the next one' sum the first n naturals: find twice the sum 1 + 2 + ... + n for n = 100.

title: Artificial Intelligence
description: Photonic neural networks and narrow AI. Unlocks the Neural Synthesizer.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the cross-entropy loss of a neural network that assigns probability p to the correct class.

title: Vacuum Energy Storage
description: Store energy in the difference between two vacua. Unlocks the Energy Cells.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the energy released when a volume V of false vacuum relaxes to the true vacuum.

title: Antimatter Containment
description: Pair production and Penning traps.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the angular cyclotron frequency of an antiproton held in a Penning trap with magnetic field B.

title: Molecular Nanotechnology
description: Assemblers that build anything atom by atom - including copies of themselves.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how many assemblers exist after t hours if one self-replicating assembler copies itself every τ hours.

title: Entangled Logistics
description: Two particles, one state - and so one channel. Unlocks Entangled Relays, Transceivers and the Entanglement Tuner.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the CHSH value S of a Werner state with visibility V = 0.9 (classical channels cannot exceed 2).

title: The Dark Sector
description: Most of the universe's mass does not interact with light. Unlocks the Dark Matter Halo Collector.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the mass enclosed within radius r of a galaxy with a flat rotation speed v - far more than the visible stars.

title: Supramolecular Chemistry
description: Molecules that build themselves into cages, frameworks and machines. Unlocks MOFs, clathrates and self-healing polymers.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Gibbs energy of binding (kJ/mol) of a host-guest complex with association constant K = 1e6 at 298 K.

title: Electrochemistry
description: Chemistry is electrons moving; push them with a voltage. Unlocks the Electrolytic Cell.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Gibbs free energy change of a Daniell cell (Zn/Cu) per mole of reaction from its cell voltage.

title: Plasma Metallurgy
description: Alloys forged in stellar plasma: Chronosteel and Exotic Solder. Unlocks the Stellar Plasma Crucible.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the mean thermal kinetic energy of a particle in a stellar plasma at temperature T.

title: Singularity Physics
description: Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Schwarzschild (event-horizon) radius of a black hole of one solar mass.

title: White Holes
description: The time-reverse of a black hole: a horizon nothing can enter.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the speed at which matter is ejected from a white hole as it passes radius r (the time reverse of infall from rest at infinity).

title: Calculus
description: Infinitesimals, derivatives and integrals - and manifolds, the spaces calculus lives on.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the slope of y = x^n at the point x, for n = 3 and x = 2.

title: Mirror Metallurgy
description: Metals that must never touch anything. Unlocks the Mirror Matter Foundry, anti-metals and the Mirror Alloy.

old_puzzle.goal: A Penning trap holds an antiproton by making it circle in a magnetic field. Find the cyclotron frequency in MHz, with q in 1e-19 C and m in 1e-27 kg.

title: Superacids
description: Acids a million million times stronger than sulfuric - strong enough to protonate almost anything.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Hammett acidity H0 of an acid in which the indicator (pK of BH+ = -10.1) is 100 times more protonated than not.

title: Fractional Distillation
description: High-tier processes leave Dimensional Residue. Distil it back into useful matter in the Fractionation Spire.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the minimum number of theoretical stages in the Fractionation Spire (Fenske equation) to reach a separation factor S with relative volatility α.

title: Stellar Engineering
description: Ignite a captive star from white-hole ejecta.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the luminosity of the ignited captive star from its radius and surface temperature (Stefan-Boltzmann law in solar units).

title: Directed Evolution
description: A million generations in a minute, if time runs fast enough. Unlocks the Evolution Engine and telomerase.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the probability that a single mutant with selective advantage s takes over a population of N (Moran process, small s).

title: Nucleosynthesis
description: Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the energy (MeV) released when four hydrogen atoms fuse into one helium-4 atom (atomic masses in u, 1 u = 931.5 MeV).

title: Quantum Gravity
description: Gravitons and spin foam: spacetime made of quanta. Unlocks the Graviton Condenser.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Planck mass, where a particle's Compton wavelength equals its own Schwarzschild radius and quantum gravity takes over.

title: Dark Energy
description: The energy of empty space itself, pushing galaxies apart.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Hubble rate when the universe was half its present size (scale factor a), with matter and dark energy (cosmological constant).

title: Traversable Wormholes
description: Black and white holes joined at the throat, propped open with negative mass.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the (negative) energy density needed at the throat of an Ellis wormhole of throat radius r (units G = c = 1).

title: Compactification
description: Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the energy of the n-th Kaluza-Klein excitation of a field on an extra dimension curled into a circle of radius R.

title: Baryon Asymmetry
description: For every billion antibaryons in the early universe there were a billion and one baryons. We are the one. Unlocks the Baryogenesis Seed.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the baryon asymmetry of the early universe: the surplus of baryons over antibaryons per photon.

title: Stellar Transcendence
description: Above stellar-core temperatures, matter stops having fixed properties. Unlocks the Transcendent Plasma Forge.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the ionisation ratio n_i/n_0 of hydrogen at thermal energy T = kT from the Saha equation, showing how heat strips matter of its atomic identity.
old_puzzle.expr: C * T ^ 1.5 * exp ( - χ / T ) / n

title: Incompleteness
description: Any system strong enough to describe arithmetic contains truths it can never prove - reality included.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Gödel number of the symbol sequence with codes (a, b, c) = (3, 1, 2), using prime-power encoding.

title: The Axiomatic Breach
description: Break every law of physics and mathematics at once, and step through the hole. Unlocks the Axiomatic Breach Engine and the Axiom Key.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Bekenstein bound (bits) on the information inside a proton of radius 0.87 fm and energy 938 MeV, with ħc = 197.3 MeV fm - the most any region can hold before physics breaks.

title: Panspermia
description: Life carried between worlds - and between universes. Unlocks panspermia seeds and the omnicellular genome.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how many spores in a meteorite survive an interplanetary journey of time t under cosmic radiation.
